parsed.rationale: The second participating record in `Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift` carries `is_sample_app: true`, which is a restraint marker that dominates any action signal. Per the decision rules, a mixed cluster where one record is a production type (the `DebugMetricsProvider` in `Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift`, package `DebugPanel`) and another is a sample-app file mandates no-action: lifting the production type into shared code would couple production semantics to demonstration/sample-app semantics. The structural near-identity (12 shared fields, only differing in `metalDevice:MTLDevice?` vs `metalDevice:(any MTLDevice)?`) is consistent with the sample app having copied the type for self-contained demonstration purposes, which is the canonical sample-app-mirror pattern.
